name: Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli
layout: Grand Prix circuit, clockwise (4.226 km, 16 turns) as used by GT4 European Series 2026 (GTWC Sprint weekend)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways (Variante del Parco 624263855, Rio, Arena, Quercia, Tramonto 624263860 (not the MotoGP long-lap loop), Curvone, Carro 624263857, Misano), graph-routed; start/finish = OSM node 4503303472 raceway=start-finish. Centre re-aligned to the measured tarmac centre.
sources.width: Measured from AGEA/PCN Ortofoto colore 2012 (Geoportale Nazionale WMS http://wms.pcn.minambiente.it/ogc?map=/ms_ogc/WMS_v1.3/raster/ortofoto_colore_12.map, ~0.4 m/px) as the contiguous asphalt run across the normal every 9 m (457 sections, median 12.0 m), outliers rejected, smoothed.
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (tile Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N43_00_E012_00_DEM, https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/). INGV TINITALY 1.1 10 m DEM (WCS https://tinitaly.pi.ingv.it/TINItaly_1_1/wcs) was compared: it agrees within 2-3 m except a 6-8 m dip along Curvone/Curva del Misano that the open, flat site does not show, so GLO-30 was kept. Emilia-Romagna DTM 5x5 WCS (servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it/wcs/dtm10k_ed2014) was tried but only serves rendered RGBA, not heights.
sources.pit: OSM raceway ways 624348305 + 624348303 (pit lane, maxspeed=60 tag), entry before Curva del Misano / pit straight, exit after Variante del Parco
sources.trim: Slow chicanes and hairpins (Parco, Rio, Quercia, Tramonto, Carro): slightly more downforce than Spa
sources.pitLimit: GT4: 50 km/h, SRO GT4 European Series 2026 pit-lane limit (stewards notices citing art. 34.11, e.g. https://www.gt4europeanseries.com/documents/notice/3047/ (Monza), DEF GT4 BRIEFING SPA 2026); TCR Europe does not race here in 2026
sources.layout: GT4 2026 Misano results PDF: "Misano World Circuit, Length: 4226m, turn count 16" (https://www.gt4europeanseries.com/results/2026/misano)

notes: Turn numbering follows the 16-turn official map (Quercia T8, Tramonto T10, Curvone T11, Carro T13-14); minor kink numbers (T3, T7, T9, T12, T15) placed at the curvature peaks. Orthophoto is from 2012 (layout unchanged). pitLoss unknown (omitted).
